outcome: Reference range of cardiac stress biomarkers
Association between delivery mode and biomarker levels
finding: This study established reference values for cord blood concentrations of cardiac stress biomarkers in healthy newborns and found that complicated delivery was associated with higher levels of CTnT, CTnI, and Copeptin.
mod_finding: Cardiac-related birth stress, as indicated by higher levels of CTnT, CTnI, and Copeptin, was found to be dependent on delivery mode.
